Utepils Cycling Sunday Road and MTB Rides

Minneapolis, MN · Bryn Mawr

Beginner friendly

Utepils Cycling Sunday Road and MTB Rides is a road and mountain bike group ride in Minneapolis, MN. It meets every Sunday, meet 9:45 am, roll 10:00 am, starting at Utepils Brewing. Expect about 15–35 miles, Road groups: Rec 11–13 mph, Sport Ultra Lite 15–17, Sport Lite 17–19, Sport 19–21; three MTB groups on the Wirth trails.

About the Utepils Cycling Sunday Road and MTB Rides group ride

Sunday morning rides from the brewery next to Theodore Wirth Park. Four road pace groups from 11 mph up, plus three mountain bike groups when the trails are dry. Everyone hangs out on the patio afterward. Helmets required.
